source.quote: Hegel's own page for the H190v, read 2026-11-24. « Digital inputs »: « 1*Coaxial S/PDIF, 24/192, 3*Optical S/PDIF, 24/96, 1*USB, 24/96, 1*Network, 24/192 ». No DSD or MQA figure anywhere on the page, and no digital-output row. No DAC chip is named anywhere on the page, and no digital filter, oversampling or NOS row exists.

facts.chip: Not named. The prose mentions only « A dedicated and improved power supply for the preamp and DAC section ».

_lusb_est_lentree_la_plus_FAIBLE_de_cet_: « 1*USB, 24/96 » against « 1*Coaxial S/PDIF, 24/192 » and « 1*Network, 24/192 ». USB, which on every other record in this catalogue is the best input, is here the worst - half the coaxial rate and level with optical. A consumer told the device does 192 kHz and connecting a computer by USB would get 96. The clearest single argument in 110 records for reading the input and not the device.
